caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet with two main sections, rendered in brown with reddish accents and some black details. The lower section consists of two rectangular panels, each containing a drawer with a round dark handle and a recessed square border highlighted in a reddish tone, along with a central door also featuring a dark knob. The upper section is narrower and is supported by two black, turned wooden columns at the front corners. This section includes small doors or panels, one in the middle with a central round knob and turned black hanging accents, and another on the left side, both with reddish square borders similar to those below. The top and upper edge of the cabinet are adorned with carved floral or foliate patterns, and the upper edges include additional reddish details in triangular shapes. The cabinet stands on four angular legs and is shown against a plain, light background.
title: Press Cupboard
